description: Benin - Slope is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Physical features", published or maintained by KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm. Slope data in degrees for Benin with a 1km x 1km resolution. The dataset was derived by KTH-dESA based on elevation data provided by CIAT (see Jarvis et al. [1]). [1] Jarvis, A., H.I. Reuter, A. Nelson, E. Guevara, 2008, Hole-filled SRTM for the globe Version 4, available from the CGIAR-CSI SRTM 90m Database (. Coverage: Benin. It has 1 file in GeoTIFF. The portal files it under Physical features. The portal gives 2008 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
